title: Normal life hit in Arunachal’s Upper Siang over hydropower project bandh

ai.summary: Organisations held a 36-hour bandh in Arunachal Pradesh's Upper Siang district to protest against a proposed 11,200-MW hydropower project, affecting schools, businesses, and markets while claiming non-fulfilment of their charter demands including releasing arrested demonstrators and halting survey activities.

facts.quote: ITANAGAR, NOV 2 (PTI): Normal life was affected in Arunachal Pradesh’s Upper Siang district on Monday with the closure of many schools, business establishments and markets as several organisations held demonstrations as part of a 36-hour bandh to protest against a proposed hydropower project.
the 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project, a mega hydropower plant planned on the Siang river

the organisations called the shutdown to protest against the alleged non-fulfilment of their charter of demands, including the release of arrested demonstrators, withdrawal of security forces and suspension of the ongoing survey activities for the 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project

ai.background_note: The Siang Indigenous Farmers' Forum opposes a proposed mega dam on the Siang in Arunachal Pradesh, which has faced sustained opposition from indigenous Adi communities due to concerns over submergence of ancestral villages, displacement, loss of agricultural land and forests, and disruption of traditional life.
